message:
docs: reconcile docs/maintainers/cognition-redesign.md

Retire the satisfied action/invention merge dependency and superseded probability-validation work, without closing live qualification or empty-scaffolding cleanup. Remove temporary .github/full-documentation-review-patch.json after validation.

edits:
- [ ] Make null/empty scaffolding disappear. The [payload inspection](../verification/level1-decisions.md#payload-inspection) found: `## General knowledge notepad` renders `{"subjectId":null,...,"text":""}` when empty; `## Me` keeps trailing spaces from empty feelings/kinship values; the combined Jev rating state carries empty values (`commitments: []`, `feelings: ""`, `goal: ""`) where generation says “None supplied.”; every generation context ends with `{"privateInventionResults":[]}` when invention is locked with no results. The original level-1 task deferred these shared files to parallel action/invention work; those integrations are now present. Current `response-context.ts` still serializes the notepad unconditionally and `actor-invention.ts` appends `privateInventionResults` even when empty. Remove redundant empty scaffolding through those existing context owners while preserving meaningful negative facts and required identity/evidence; no branch-merge prerequisite remains.
- [ ] Verify live Jev choice parsing, confidence/probabilities, BYOK connection selection, spending and NPC/invention routing. Setup/provider documentation reflects this route; complete qualification remains pending. The [survival diagnosis](../verification/embodied-survival.md#renewed-jev-only-diagnosis-and-hunting-demonstration) observed four `invalid_probabilities` failures in diagnostic batches containing 42-option Choice questions. Those failures remain historical observations, with their original cause unestablished. The later [purpose-based validation audit](../verification/validation-purpose.md) supersedes the decoder’s sum-to-one, named-choice agreement and conventional-range assertions: current Choice decoding requires usable finite scores for offered choices, selects the highest raw score and uses offer order for exact ties. Qualify the current decoder and remaining live routes rather than reimplementing that repair. Replaying the original failed records may establish which old check rejected them; the audit alone does not prove their cause. Do not normalize raw scores or retry automatically. The diagnosis’s independent-Noul hunt trials remain evidence only for their recorded outcomes.
